annotation.title_clean: 国家戦略特別区域法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the National Strategic Special Zones Act
annotation.summary_en: Japanese Cabinet Office ordinance implementing the National Strategic Special Zones Act. It sets procedures for business implementation plans, zone plan approval, designated corporations and tax/financing incentives. Robots for surgical assistance, daily-living training, medical and care use, and autonomous IoT products appear only as eligible R&D/manufacturing business categories.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines eligible specified businesses, including R&D and manufacture of robots for surgical assistance, daily-living training, medical and care use.
Sets submission procedures for business implementation plans and zone plan approval.
Establishes designation of corporations for tax special measures (Art. 11-2 to 11-5), including R&D of autonomously operating products.
Sets requirements for designated companies receiving investment tax incentives, with annual reporting.
Amended effective 2026-04-01 by Cabinet Office Ordinance No. 31 of Reiwa 8.
